!C-MUBZ5-20  # d 5 is offered in L 6* (thin only), 8, (9), 10, 12, (15): no L 20 (p.514)
!C-MUBZ5-6  # L 6 for d 5 is marked * (thin wall type only); the standard wall type has no L 6
!C-MUBZU5-9  # L 9 is bracketed: standard wall type only, not the thin wall type (p.514)
!C-MUBZU32-30  # no thin wall version for d 32 (thin wall d 5-30, 35, 40, 50; p.514)
!C-MUBZ110-100  # the straight type is offered up to d 100
!C-MUFZU18-20  # no thin wall shouldered bushing for d 18 (p.514)
!C-MUFZ14-10  # no d 14: the shouldered type is offered for d 5, 6, 8, 10, 12, 13, 15, 16, 18, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90, 100
!C-MUTSZ6-15  # L 15 for d 6 is bracketed: round and compact flanged only, not the square flange (p.515)
!C-MUTZ60-50  # flanged bushings are offered up to d 50 (p.515)
!E-SHTZ35-40  # special brass flanged bushings are offered for d 6-30 only (p.520)
!E-SHBZ32-30  # special brass straight bushings are offered for d 5-30 (p.519)
!E-SHFZ18-20  # no d 18 in the special brass shouldered table (p.519)
!E-MUGZ6-10  # d 6 is offered in L 12 only (p.516)
!E-MUSZ10-15  # the countersunk thrust type is not generated
!C-MUFZ10  # an ordering code needs <type><d>-<L>
